description: Get recent Cryptowisser news about a specific coin, token, company, exchange, person, regulator, law, country or story, for example "Bitcoin", "Binance", "CZ", "SEC" or "Bitget hack". Names, tickers and common aliases are recognised. Use from/to for a specific period.

entity.description: The coin, company, person or story, e.g. "Solana", "Coinbase", "Vitalik Buterin", "Bitget hack".

from.description: Optional. Only articles published on or after this date or datetime (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Number of articles to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.

to.description: Optional. Only articles published on or before this date or datetime. Defaults to now.

name: news-about
title: News About
